417542.overview: RAFALE X is a flight simulator for a state-of-the-art bison device. It includes all phases of an interception flight at the controls of a combat jet. The take-off, refueling in flight, air combat, return flight ( with or without refueling ), landing and debriefing are simulated.

417543.overview: This side view, single player, platform game was only sold at Frederick Raynal's father store called "Videomatique". 80 copies were sold. This is the first published game by Frederick Raynal when he was 18.
